name: Steve Scalise
subject: I feel like I need to say I’m sorry...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
| I need to apologize to you.
I'm sorry, truly I am.
I'm sorry that some people accuse you of not being MAGA if you don't make a donation.
I'm sorry that some people lie to you about who they are to try to trick you into donating.
And I'm sorry that many folks don't even show their appreciation when you do donate.
It drives me crazy that people try to treat you like that, and it's important to hear why I do things differently.
First things first.
This is Majority Leader Steve Scalise.
Secondly, I want to thank you for all of the support you've given to the GOP over the years; it really means a lot.
But right now we're staring down some concerning numbers, and it has my team and I really worried.
The Democrats are currently unloading 100 million dollars into 35 GOP seats to obliterate our House Majority once and for all, and here is the truth: Right now, we simply don't have the funds to fully fund our campaign operations in all 35 races.
[So the simple truth is that I need your help before our House Majority is a thing of the past.](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=74d107f48a48411d96754a7ac4546805&_e=eK1oRY-N9Z9lNSU5vwqdiCk3DApVyPvyQldDrKfjLVmq0pOzabudQvpsS2SVMPdAbWFSO29Ro0dxg-Ey3JmdbP-bdwR8_-zodV1sovQknIixCR20B7ycsSB4DuB8SnKemxSs1P1SHduuVjIIsxGiAQwK8XBccXRHUIGs-w9sZc_3Xr23bzWBpKlmIFWP9oqw4eDxL97_LRXstrCbD1t5vtHzFENFRc6pmIDkKyjw-JALirFJixr5W-QrD4W9LhdUAdBs20PIkABu-W3kxc3v0btZSKyNie4X1GRh3LoLr3ZcXEpjCmdJISSNK8hnx8oSHGnJE4mG5qaZdXv0dDYVicAu66v0YMm-T7LoSi0neHhN8uquEAlqgZI3ZhXTTQio67b5Trrv3-1oquAH8Wtv_gW4lz87M4IXbeXIS2PsAlLh8CdwRla-54gHTtIjdFGP7OlskcYWELt_yI_OiDKHYERbDA0vcMId5YVN0xHmyH6zfJNGPQ9h-hs1tbm4HfuDWWosgk0Twtdi-dVF6zCG23qLEvKeqSoKbQEcgoBKqdZANuq5VWBp-wFrryAhPD88dBJwrE-VxDfvYkX0t6_XRnoXIZeEQ049VrrR5glHjX3fsMxZPbjo1Z3q-f6MRZsfKTUwsaVClAUFwEmvky_4VfleFVbvCP-R0eA766j6_oWlp5CL6XY1k0gAePv145XY)
If you can't afford to help right now, no problem. I won't hold that against you. Taking care of your loved ones always comes first. I will never question your Party loyalty or shame you for not making a donation.
HOWEVER - if you can make a donation, I promise not a single penny will go unnoticed, and it will go a long way to helping to save our House Majority.
Because right now we're facing down our critical end-of-month deadline, and it's looking like we'll fall well short of the goals that I set out.
[I’m sorry to be a bother, really I am, but are you willing to chip in just a few bucks to help us crush our major fundraising deadline?](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=74d107f48a48411d96754a7ac4546805&_e=eK1oRY-N9Z9lNSU5vwqdiCk3DApVyPvyQldDrKfjLVmq0pOzabudQvpsS2SVMPdAbWFSO29Ro0dxg-Ey3JmdbP-bdwR8_-zodV1sovQknIixCR20B7ycsSB4DuB8SnKemxSs1P1SHduuVjIIsxGiAQwK8XBccXRHUIGs-w9sZc_3Xr23bzWBpKlmIFWP9oqw4eDxL97_LRXstrCbD1t5vtHzFENFRc6pmIDkKyjw-JALirFJixr5W-QrD4W9LhdUFlcfQvKARKAPgYMkzt2XTCLOscOLqFVbP4pQ096iTrLF4HWR7zlZjTIYsCUEZR_JkBZeRlF-aoklv_C83F9hhqNbwrK1gKN_Gk-ZuILcZdsV1h-cCbsG1nXUjsAxrwr6fHdUUmI9xsYLjV7OSDuI84oM2TmheGqZjggCCTNPQvU3l2CIwyxENehChGXj0eDZQ76gd1IPybeMBivrXytMh4DAWLItBkVZL7X2FmGetFEbczgAQCgfQ4L--NYOcazeqfTKePQDeQEkcBRB3XM7Sn0OjWROlPQ0dlCqJS9VQCfphhXPpxYMy71d5wSVpBeTRxtgwNgFfUJ2UQfVcK9Yef3J5Rbe1xN7TjMD0teZcfAuGuaGE28Ues6BAfTnx9ZkU-9QBEGtWhjhLjT4c9-cM2G83Ewh7xXrwUWa-3KGlbU9VOeKmQVkZDdjxFAhago2)

body:
Every suppressive action these vengeful partisans take shows their true colors. For all their talk about election integrity, voter ID, and not harming eligible voters, closing legitimate polling places to make it harder to vote only has one logical end result.
Attacks by opponents of voting rights on young voters, mail-in ballots, early voting, and more aren't about integrity and fairness. It's about protecting their own power at any cost and tilting the playing field before the game has even been played.
We must stand up to stop them at every turn. RUSH $35 or more today to help us fight back in North Carolina and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052826_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NC Newsline: Amid protests, NC elections board rejects campus voting sites and Sunday voting in several counties [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052826_3&amount=25]
We're now facing the repercussions of the partisan election takeover laws that went into effect at the end of 2024, Team.
To refresh your memory: After the 2024 elections and the defeat of a MAGA candidate for governor, opponents of voting rights in North Carolina jammed through a bill that took the power of the governor to appoint people to election boards and handed that to the state auditor . It's worth noting that the state auditor is the only statewide elected Republican, with Democrats winning the 2024 races for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, and secretary of state.
Now, among massive protests from young voters, the MAGA-fied North Carolina State Elections Board recently shot down proposals to continue having early voting sites on several universities around the state . These weren't new sites either; these were places where North Carolina had provided early voting locations for a decade or more.
This is voter suppression, plain and simple, by making it harder for eligible, registered voters to vote in-person by taking away their polling place. It's another demonstration of how opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections.
We have to fight these suppressive actions in North Carolina and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today to help every eligible voter cast their ballot >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052826_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

These new, highly partisan State Election Board members wouldn't even look the protestors in the eye or engage with their proposals. After the vote, Chairman Francis De Luca threatened to call the cops on students if they didn’t leave.
Need to better understand how this impacts young voters? Western Carolina University in Jackson County, for example, has had a polling place on campus since 2016 that’s been used in five general elections and four primaries, according to a document prepared for the board. The state board voted 3-2 to get rid of it.
Closing the campus voting site would not save money, but “ would create barriers to voting for young, rural residents ,” Jackson County Board member Betsy Swift told the state board. 64% of students don’t have vehicles to drive to the polling place, she said.
Without the on-campus site, the closest polling place for students will be a recreation center nearly two miles away. Students without transportation will have to walk along a four-lane highway and through a meadow to get there.
Voter suppression isn't just black and white photos of eligible voters being turned away from polling places. Voter suppression is making it harder for eligible voters to take part in our elections through onerous ID requirements, closing polling places, taking away voting locations, or ending mail-in voting. Every time someone makes it harder to cast your ballot, voters are suppressed.
It's not going to end until we stop them.

I’ve personally worked with Julia on crucial issues, such as securing the border, cutting your taxes, and lowering the cost of living. She’s as America First as it gets! As Senator, she’ll be a reliable vote for the SAVE America Act, President Trump’s nominees, and the entire agenda to Make America Great Again. [**This is a longer email, but I humbly ask you to read it and consider joining my team at the end.**](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=ca10967e65334e0e859055ed4761a4c2&_e=iDoofNiSfBw6Yb9CtXQ2i6ATalEkIiZF95I8lwIZbqxl5DQZGzjjlkom9Mq9WE2mwJk3ixBgvk2veG4H2mETOxP9oC9Wvc4r8Lsbo6qKkmfHpzSo1uNReCJkQgJEC1IzjDntlVn3y5avZugkSv8IPbwAanhO9M4KbxYulv_61tIwqNEI5QV962OR486YUKJAr1kMvRSq_lm6hVsPzk71PmQpaeFU6i6yM9g8vqC7eOooBnAObNSaOB33fSLan-6LswJGWhZmF6rOJa-s_yFBewJQME7ohWdp1d1pwOTYWYFtQ5Uqfh-jiiNtnzaXFmeIiZQXlxMv1-iiCFuyYy-xo38AKFCl80nzlbtZDVUBDkZYCIM1X7mtQ_hiWsKtDg6I7_JGM96qHBEuFtXThZ_uWLwa7Hogt0PuIzHNa96wW3mtjeZHVb9Y3FlvOroI_60Mb-RgZuyVO9SrmP2Yi_K8Opo4fWT8WZPMUUt8UqVQUf4k111gwp8HcGSCCYuoPo4zqQDv-ElFH23FfoIqlUJ2bwwr2urJsZDvkyrAmqaKjyg%3D)

**In case you don 't know me, my name is Joe Males, and I'm a proud Mexican-American, U.S. Marine Veteran, small business owner, and a city councilman who's running for Congress in CA-25. But above all else, I'm a father who is still in mourning.**

[](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=ca10967e65334e0e859055ed4761a4c2&_e=iDoofNiSfBw6Yb9CtXQ2i6ATalEkIiZF95I8lwIZbqxl5DQZGzjjlkom9Mq9WE2mwJk3ixBgvk2veG4H2mETOxP9oC9Wvc4r8Lsbo6qKkmfHpzSo1uNReCJkQgJEC1IzjDntlVn3y5avZugkSv8IPbwAanhO9M4KbxYulv_61tIwqNEI5QV962OR486YUKJALP1LMVotA16h8SjnM47a0sNaDT8NBy6pYgMSoouxk_UTuLldxDu9em-6bXHoTJ8MMIE6wf7r6rxpTS1sA9c8AFpiVBnTtm7esxx1h8XKTFxIKyfJIjQZ7zoynzt97l_-AfOxGN3R8syVVhzUPuRWX37U7IskDunwYtUDE3LQjoUgXWp7XXgoSphDaUWDLiy-plCqFNUCU9H3zG-ewZPJXLJ_4XjIoSJe68NHLZvSODNqXTFqXCw_sl4eQZY2UaEWEycEOL0R89a2DNtT2v8J-j254a4lFRL6GMJzXw5yUnU-IV7tcrxnkAqSDxMjG-Dko7GeC__0Q5sqwEeOXoRZ28z6LRNDPl9VQPUQCB7_s2I%3D)
**I ran for city council and am running for Congress because of my son, Nicholas.**

In 2016, Nicholas came home to visit for his sister's birthday and Father's Day. It was supposed to be a wonderful time to bring our family back together. Then, he was tragically stabbed to death in my hometown of Hemet, California.

[](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=ca10967e65334e0e859055ed4761a4c2&_e=iDoofNiSfBw6Yb9CtXQ2i6ATalEkIiZF95I8lwIZbqxl5DQZGzjjlkom9Mq9WE2mwJk3ixBgvk2veG4H2mETOxP9oC9Wvc4r8Lsbo6qKkmfHpzSo1uNReCJkQgJEC1IzjDntlVn3y5avZugkSv8IPbwAanhO9M4KbxYulv_61tIwqNEI5QV962OR486YUKJAszoMcPgDVYGw_PvPzXAW5M3TU6eaT9im-k5iuTBK0MQ2LxHBN8ZpR9_CBVrpG8OJMAZ1lt4SdVa__6qAsEDpL1C3nPE_hE_13kW-LGxLboNX8963LBXNJtYjuXc0JTLfFz_hkWNLvzE17OQOv4SmkDz6dANkpdxga-8UQflk4mankY4vFq6BINoMcCaY3ZWX8NrXND1k6-ICQMmoDLVRt55Rng_6mL0EzgwkiXxbxuwRUSBRASQpfoOSdLNRPMUYuJjl0L1OpJVr4Oziiq3GEDDE_G4CJ3q_1XyAANVNc9o3mT4w6qqmqF1OSgwys9Js2qniLrQIpAK1hfTKA6TyYbSIeMYnzkgr_7xhZQz_sd4%3D)
No one stepped forward with information on my son's killer, so the case went cold. After five years of not knowing anything about what happened, I decided to do something about it. I ran for City Council, and just a few months later, by the grace of God, they found the killer.

As a parent, losing your child is the most difficult thing to go through. But I'm pushing through it and am committed to making him proud as I fight for a better tomorrow for his children.

I'm grateful to Hemet's law enforcement, who was able to find the killer and arrest him.

Nicholas serves as a daily reminder to me to never take a single precious moment for granted and that I must continue to fight every single day for a better future.

subject: What’s happening in New Hampshire.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
Chris Pappas is in a tied race — and Republicans are coming for this seat.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260528_3.faIFtu&refcode=em20260528-3&t=1&akid=6884%2E582294%2EmXIcRX)
Hi, it’s Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear.
There’s a lot of noise in an election year — I know that better than most. But let me be very clear: **The Senate race in New Hampshire could decide the direction of this country.**
Chris Pappas is running in a tied race. It could be a toss-up. And with Donald Trump in the White House, the stakes couldn’t be higher.
**[That’s why I’m asking you to chip in $5, or anything you can, right now to help Chris Pappas win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260528_3.faIFtu&refcode=em20260528-3&t=2&akid=6884%2E582294%2EmXIcRX)**
The first year of this second Trump Administration has seen chaos, division, and dangerous rollbacks of basic freedoms. That’s why it’s so important we elect leaders like Chris Pappas — leaders who know how to bring people together, deliver real results, and never forget who they’re fighting for.
Chris’s opponent is a former U.S. Senator with national name recognition and the backing of national Republicans and their deep-pocketed super PACs. Republicans believe they can flip this seat and block any chance we have of checking Trump’s power in Washington.
But I believe in Chris — and I believe we can win.
Chris understands that leadership isn’t about grabbing headlines or scoring political points. It’s about showing up, listening, and doing the hard work to deliver for working families. He’s done that in Congress, and I know he’ll bring that same spirit of public service to the Senate.
Kentucky and New Hampshire may look different, but our constituents are people who want the same things: good jobs, strong schools, access to health care, and a future we can build together. That’s what Chris Pappas is fighting for. **_But he can’t do it alone._**
**[If you’re with me — and ready to stop Trump and his allies from flipping this critical seat — chip in now to help Chris Pappas win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260528_3.faIFtu&refcode=em20260528-3&t=3&akid=6884%2E582294%2EmXIcRX)**

Thank you for standing up and stepping in when it counts.
Let’s get Chris across the finish line.
Thank you,
Andy Beshear
Governor of Kentucky

On Friday morning over 600 hundred Louisianans showed up to the Louisiana state capitol to protest and speak out against a new Congressional map proposed by the Louisiana GOP that will erase Louisiana's two black majority districts and establish all white districts.
During the hearing on redistricting, GOP State Senator Jay Morris yelled "Shut up, boy" to my Executive Director Dadrius Lanus, a Black man, who, in Sen. Morris’s words was “commenting and talking” too loudly for him to concentrate.
Sir, I am a 70 year old Black man and we know what it means to be called “Boy.”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
Senator Morris says we misheard. That the audio proves it. That he said “you all need to shut up” to the Black constituents behind him outraged that their votes won't be counted.
Senator Morris, an elected member of our legislature, thinks if he had yelled “you all need to shut up” it would be better.
It wouldn't.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that White people have been telling Black folk to “shut up" for over 250 years.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that we remember being told we were 3/5ths of a person. That even when we won personhood in the eyes of the law, they instituted poll taxes and “reading” tests. That when we marched and dreamed and cried and buried loved ones who had hung as strange fruit from tall trees because they raised their voices too loud that what Black people have always wanted is equality.
Or maybe Senator Morris does understand all that.
I don’t know.
What I do know is that I am a 70 year old Black man. And I don’t let anyone call me or my brothers “Boy.”

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Your labs said "normal." You felt anything but.
body:
Plus: Comply with our illegal law — or we'll sue you. Only in NM | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/haON_ZN2WzD?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
New Mexico Democrats passed an anti-ICE law — and now they're threatening to sue their own counties over the very law the DOJ is suing the state for. [We break down the hypocrisy.](https://us.list-manage.com/QkHzmSzyWBo?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
**Then we switch gears completely:** ER veteran [Jalayne Faulhaber](https://us.list-manage.com/flCjnRz2RJt?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) joins us to bust the HRT, GLP-1, and testosterone myths that keep people scared — starting with the 2002 study that misled a whole generation of women.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/bqee8wfi95L?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🏛️ **DEMS THREATEN COUNTIES OVER A LAW THE DOJ IS SUING THEM FOR**
House Bill 9 — the "Immigrant Safety Act" — bars New Mexico counties from cooperating with ICE. Otero County signed a five-year contract and told Santa Fe exactly where to put it.
Now Democratic leaders are warning those counties: fall in line, or get sued.
The problem? The federal government is already suing the state over the same law. And one Democratic senator said something in that hearing that quietly gives the whole game away.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/1D4ykb_scyD?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🔥 **"NORMAL" LABS — AND STILL FEELING TERRIBLE**
Krysty had done all the bloodwork. Every result came back "normal." She still wasn't sleeping, the weight wouldn't budge, and the joint pain wouldn't quit.
Jalayne explains the difference between "normal" and "optimal" — and why one number told a completely different story than Krysty's old doctor did.
**Then there's HRT. That single 2002 study scared a generation of women away from it. Jalayne breaks down what she says it got wrong — hear it before you make up your mind.
** ⚠️ **THE VIAL LABELED "RESEARCH ONLY"**
GLP-1s are everywhere now — and so is the temptation to buy them cheap online.
One of Jalayne's patients did exactly that. The first injection, she was fine. The second one, she passed out in her driveway and ended up in the ER.
What was actually in that vial — and why "too good to be true" almost always is.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/tRWaKv0lkBF?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |

PLUS: Mark reads the column from the Santa Fe writer who spent 2022 trashing him — wait until you hear what the critic finally admits. And for the guys: why "normal" testosterone might be exactly why you crash every afternoon at 3 p.m.

🩺 **WORK WITH JALAYNE**
Our guest is Jalayne Faulhaber, FNP, at Foundation Health & Wellness in Albuquerque.

**Web:** [foundationhw.com](https://us.list-manage.com/d5_1E3iG5gJ?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
**Instagram:** [@foundationhealthwellness](https://us.list-manage.com/ZenDpBD0m5w?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
**Facebook:** [Foundationhw](https://us.list-manage.com/1BQ93qKbNnG?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---

## US-Iran Reach Tentative Deal to Reopen Strait
U.S. and Iranian negotiators have [reached a draft deal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOmzAURp_GbDcy1ySEwUOqCnVJlw6VuqCLfR1cGRvZJihvX9FX-OcjffrO-f2cnuSDj6-ftLKuLk2RjxK4Vs7TXnymaJmC8fRKwZZKZaFoJ5R4A3kFHCZLPnymrrHaMSOrhnXb36XsBhxUs2ij0PTYdjPbHs3gbqobsMMZLV1bml3j9bkmrzi0Ut5bvChue3m_9mpmpQaSopNsfU358jf5WBd24ZPenC8mrU3QS61bEeohcBQ4HsdxWUs8mcCRI-xF4HhKnTDlYAWOxaS0wV6AooXTETKTWeBUhXmvEJkt1LyvWwHnIwWgbcvpTQGSc954CgUKfQSOlOHxwG55_Pgj1JiMt0J9_3YW5aP84rw1Wdvt8CH4cutFJ18r-fD_e_1S8LfGfwEAAP__35WWDg) to extend the ceasefire and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, pending final approval from President Trump. The 60-day agreement would unrestrict [shipping through the strait](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOwyAQBdDT2B0RDNiGgmKbdNl2S2swQ8wKmwhIIt9-5Vxhy9FI_-v9n9t8w5jifv_GjWwLed7pXRO1RmV-1lhw94RpiXjPydeGdcXdz8BhZHxgYGaPMR2z6r0NRECyJysmzbkyYGS_Wi8VBqX1wkkYHRQ6ByTQ8DEEcJProz3T-ABGcK4FXCSJiethko6kNMg7xcnHlsvlN8e9rRTSkV9ULkve-mTX1h61k18dXDu44uMEnK_zKC0uiTq4nhD2rOyNheWY2IYHA80-Dh0G8qCFdDhKHyYksyyOjBGj1h5MX6x_vGNKsY5Tp_h9w5g-5e1fi70s_AUAAP__vg19GA), require Iran to remove all mines within 30 days, and lift U.S. sanctions on Iranian oil sales. Even as the draft was finalized, [Iran fired a ballistic missile](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGunDAQBdCvMZ2RGcOCCxdp6DZtSjTGwzKJwcg2izZf_8T7hdfOSFf33D_P6YkceH_9xo1sWeK005UDlUJpOjMn3D1hmBlfMfhcMK-4-wkUPKTqJJjJI4fP1FbeLkRAuiLb9INSrQGjq9UOM7rWPXzfmo7crKgbjNPgwPUDDOQrtnea6sA0Sg0N1JqaXg1drx1pbVCJVpHnElP9N_JeVlrCJ74p1XPcqmDXUo4s9C8Bo4Dxuq56dvlW3H8BY-A3yfPwWCgLGG-SvDDJM8tcEv-jLEs6t0PGDff7hFxkXOQa03b-lzdfwFgl64-LQ-D86EWrXhty-G5QfjTb28JXAAAA__9Yt4No) at Kuwait on Wednesday night that was intercepted, retaliating for U.S. strikes on Iranian drone facilities.
## US Postal Service Strikes $10B Deal with DHL
The cash-strapped U.S. Postal Service [announced a $10 billion deal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOpDAQBNCvMRnIbpsBAgeXkM2lFyJjN9CnxkbYM7P8_Yr9hc0qeCqV6t9zejpiiutft6MtS5oifjJjKXhOr0yniwEde3Jr4pCLy5uLYQIJj1q2NQxTcMTXZKpgF0RAXaFVXS-lGWDQ1Wa90vMQFIBRg4F2VoDoQOneeN2Zdq7I3m2yhUFJ2StoNKpO9m2nZ9R6cFIYiYFKOpv_iWLZcOErvfFsfNortlspRxb6j4BRwLhQdNFjc7ktpVsIGNGnmPZLwHgkJn8HdxbyjFnA-MpHrjOtMddK1jMxU4o1fnl-ZXpjrR6m1RJa02xl5-q04fjcKD86YeS6O-KfJeVX970tfAcAAP__Z7SDQw) Thursday to handle "last-mile" delivery for Germany's DHL eCommerce, the biggest contract in the two organizations' 25-year relationship. DHL will handle pickup and sorting at its [19 American hubs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNqLnZ8D24KFLtnTtiB72M7h1ANlOovx9RX-h49WV7tU5X7fpRjHFbfmkO9sa9mnjV0lcK-fpUWKmzTMlF2nZky-VykqbnxBw7GDo0EyeYnpPfettYEaWLVuhNEBv0Mh2tQGDBjE6pWaahcTRjCYYPfaIPA9ettGeazCgEQBa4EWyUKAHJWeW0hA0PbCPdc-X7z1udeWQ3vuT88Xt9zbZtdajNPKjwWuDVzpOgLM6Q67RJW7w-ihH6fyauoPcDy3ceU7xyfndCTKs-h61kqxUkGpG50A4FjNoz7rN1h-vmFIso2p6WO4U0991_Zevp8XfAAAA__-BdnzS), while USPS completes the final leg of deliveries to its network of 170 million addresses nationwide. The deal is a major win for USPS, which has [warned it could run out of cash](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO4yAQxfHT2B3WMOAYCopt3GXbLa0JjGNW2ESAY-X2q-wVvvLpSb_i_-e-3CmmeDx_086urXk5-KqJW-OynDUWOgJT8pGeOYXaqG50hAUBbwJGgXYJFNNn0X1wKzOy6tnJyQBoi1b1mzPS21UbyZ4loA4BJrIPFQyN3819dF8NRrQSwEgcFMsJzDipBytlCToNHGLLZfib49E2XtMnv7kMPu99cltrr9qpXx3OHc7XdQ2U0_frcKbSok9cO5zP-qrC5zMFUc5DeKqbkCgQ1KjNzdpha3vqiwuvK6YU623qNDx3iv-tvv0oztvhvwAAAP__42x2_g) as early as 2027 after losing $9 billion in the last fiscal year. It comes just two months after Amazon, USPS's largest customer, slashed its package volume with the agency [by 20%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OpDAQBOCngczItPlz4OASsrn0QtSDG-iTsUe2B2v26VfsK2xeKtVX_x7LA9mx3__iSSZvYfFUkqOcKS7vxBG9JXQr4x6cTRnTgd4uIGEQshegF4vsPktXW7MRAamaTDtOUnYatKoP006q050d9AB91-K6rU8EAomt6kFLW7O522QPupVyaqFR1I5y6kf1JKU0yqqTZDmH2PwP7PNBm_uEi2KzhrN25sj5lSr1p4K5grmU0myReD9ywYvSHapgvlUVzHjiV_Ai8e6T8FSEJccXxY-4laJwPsQrpIxOJIoXryQwC5DCUUriCu59Uh2NfRV2jtMwVp3cT2T3syX_6sDLwHcAAAD__9WJhps) in a renegotiated contract.
## Ex-CIA Officer Caught with $40M Gold Stash
A former senior CIA officer is in federal jail after agents allegedly [found 303 gold bars](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHOpDAMhuHThM6jYGCAgmIbun_bLZEhDngVklESGM3tV5krbGfJ0iN975-f5YfEid9_08lTtmHx_E6Oc-a4XEkiecPkNqE9OJMypYO8WVDjE3QHOC6GxH2WtjKTZUZuKp7qftC6HXFsqmMa-rG3m6WN-5XJ4tCOz9WuQ1fbGrHrKpmKpjsca62HGh8N170eur5ZuWlG0qrVbCSH-PgbxOeDrfuEm-NjC2flpiPnV1LNL4Wzwtl_XiHl8lI4F1jhrLtyDwrnK0HZp3A-whs2IQjWysYRtuBv8RsbuBLshfcn-ww5wC43wyEntBpOcU6CB_FQgsBKMQF9VSDneKcswSegNVwZDknwopQh8s3k2CicqziZ17sw6dmrVu8niftOyf_V_57wXwAAAP__OGKbIw) worth more than $40 million stashed in his Virginia home, along with $2 million in cash and 35 luxury watches. David Rush [requested the gold and foreign currency](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAURp8GOwwCihYUf2M3f7uluQPX8W4QJoBjfPuN-wpbf8mXc87XY3kABYqv_7CjrWtaIp4lYK2Yl6NQhugRgiN4peBLhbJB9IsUcuCi53JaPFC4Ft14uyJKVA3azoxC6ElOqtlsJ82AGoSCaRw0ajWMPTjvwY9q1agbsveb6OXUCTF2slXYGTH2Rj1RqQkE0wI91ZTb70SxbriGK30wty7tTbBbre_C1D8mZybn8zzb-HS3xb0zOb9ToEquMDlHqJQiBF7QHZnqxeS8prxj5o6Ap3Ulh5mDc0dBz0tFuNtwJQS__fkTcuElHdlh4QUunl0EpU1nTJOtf58UApXBMC1eO1D4Rax_6vqx8icAAP__UhGOKA) from the government between November 2025 and March, claiming the funds were for unspecified "work-related expenses." The CIA reportedly handed it over. He's also accused of [posing as a Navy Reserve captain and test pilot](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLESmzAQRL8GumMOCQwUKtK4c9qUzIFOcIlAHkkGO1-fwb-QZpvd2dm3vx7jg8TLvvykjU12Ydz5TJ5z5ji-kkTaLZOfhZbgbcqUVtrtqFDdAFtQw2hJ_GdsSmscs2Jdsqm7HrEZ1KDL1aiZmdykW1RK18yDvQ1IPWo9M9KEpZirDVs11Ih9rSrNdYd92-mJtR4IiwbZSg6x-h1kzys7_wkHx2oOW-nNmvMzFfpHoe6Fup_nWbnwviguv1D3V_oKOLYJEstfhgY3uHhgophgprRCDJ7ffAV2CRFeCZZwZAjOySzkwdEftrDT8YGn-JDLaOzzFO8l3bqiwWUj8d9F-b9uPIz6FwAA__9s8okI) for years, even though his actual Navy job was as an information systems technician. The FBI says Rush [faked college degrees](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu3CAUBNCvwR0WBtaYgiJS5O6liaKU1n1wsW-E4QnYXfnvI-cXUo90NDO_P7YPoER5_wEnuh7LlvHdEvaOdXs2qpADQvIEe0mhdWgH5LBJIWcuHlzaLQCla9NDcBFRohrQTWYRQltp1XA4XKTV2uvFGK2meQnGzPMiInhrATwO5G5NPKSdhFgmOSqcjFgeRn2iUhYE0wID9VLHP4VyPzCmq7ywjr6cQ3JH71-NqW9Mrkyu8OnvBeNe7pjJ9ddPJtdY6omVewJeYiSPlUNKuGNIFw8YKzwDBr7fbD4xd54uyjv3FQPmTpAak2vrpV5MrRSY-j4ppeZZiGmoLny9KSVqs2Fa7CdQ-tet_9ehLyf_BgAA__9xfYod) from Clemson and Rensselaer Polytechnic, and pocketed $77,000 in fraudulent military leave by claiming active reserve duty he wasn't performing.
